summary: A school-name advocate answers an advertising objection by pointing to the school’s years of local service.
realLife: After the Concept Creek proposal failed, its advocate cited the nonprofit school’s local history and backing from two townships. Staff suggested contacting Pennsylvania’s names committee.
inGame: needs: the rejection, the advocate’s account of the school and the state committee’s response.

turns.pulledBy: The state committee sends a new recommendation.
turns.writesBack: The reconsideration request has new evidence.

turns.what: The clerk records the advocate’s objection.
